- Scope: NomadPay traffic experienced P95/P99 latency increases and ~0.6% request 5xx rate during the 08:15–09:10 PT window on 2026-03-18.

Immediate remediation (we completed):
- Paused the noisy workload and applied per-tenant min-share enforcement.
- Applied per-shard throttles and cleared the KV cache pressure.
- Verified that no active kernel rollbacks were required; engineering is continuing validation.

Recommended near-term customer actions (needs your approval):
1) Authorize a burst reservation for 3 hours starting now to provide headroom and stabilize P99 (we will invoice as burst credits; we can discuss a temporary credit against next month).
2) If you prefer not to use burst credits, we can run a 5-minute hosted failover test — this requires short token rotation and a quick smoke test on your side.

- Approve a short customer credit conversation if revenue impact is proven; ops to capture traffic window and conversion delta for claims.
